items.title: HHS Band of Gold Video Archives
items.description: These files are the archived videos of performances by the Hendersonville Band of Gold in Hendersonville, Tennessee. The videos are posted for viewing on our alumni Facebook page and are also posted here as a backup and to allow our alumni to download the videos they want.
